verdict: Choose MioCommerce when live pricing booking pages plus scheduling, dispatch, CRM, and payments for home/commercial services is the job. Compare ServiceM8 and Contractor Foreman for overlapping trades FSM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-09-06 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm live Grow/ProMax amounts on the vendor pricing page before purchase.
strengths: Live pricing and real-time booking pages for service ecommerce
Scheduling, dispatch, CRM, invoicing, and payments in one platform
Essentials entry at $19/mo annual with 15-day trial
Flat-rate unlimited-user positioning on team plans
weaknesses: Grow/ProMax list prices need live confirmation (contactSales in research pack)
Essentials caps users and monthly bookings
Smaller comparison mesh vs CRM categories on this site
bestFor: Home cleaning, mobile auto, landscaping, plumbing, and similar service SMBs
Teams that need live pricing / real-time booking pages plus back-office ops
Buyers wanting flat-rate team plans instead of per-seat FSM bills
notIdealFor: Software/IT project management (Jira-class) as the primary job
Enterprise FSM needing deep custom quoting beyond published tiers without a demo
Buyers requiring a peer mesh of many SoftwareGlimpse FSM comparisons today
tradeoffs: Live pricing booking emphasis vs mature trades FSM peers
Published Essentials/Startup floors vs confirm-live Grow/ProMax
All-in-one service ops vs specialist dispatch-only tools
recommendation: Choose MioCommerce when field service booking, scheduling, dispatch, and payments for home/commercial services is the primary job.
editorialNotes: Locale-410 gap recovery. Approved on project-management-editorial v1.0.0. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.
